en.summary: This refines L2 directory flush response validity so valid is asserted only for dirty entries or the final last_flush marker.
why_it_counts: The patch fixes protocol-level valid signaling in the L2 directory flush engine.
It preserves the needed completion marker on the last flush while avoiding unconditional valid on every clean entry.
The change is a precise DUT logic correction in a cache-control module.
evidence: io.result.valid changes from unconditional true.B on the registered flush path to io.result.bits.last_flush || RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue).
The last_flush bit is already generated from RegNext(flushDone), so the patch is clearly about end-of-flush response semantics.
The modified logic sits in Directory_test.scala, the L2 directory implementation module.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory flush io.result.valid and last_flush completion signaling
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Restore io.result.valid to unconditional true.B on the registered flush path instead of last_flush || dirty-line gating.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Clean non-final flush steps generate spurious valid responses, confusing flush accounting or downstream sequencing.
notes: This is the clean final fix in the flush-valid series.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A flush engine should not advertise a response for every clean line it walks. Correct behavior is to respond when a line needs writeback or when the controller must signal the terminal completion step.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush iterates across clean non-final lines.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Assert flush response valid on every flush step instead of only on dirty steps or the final completion marker.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replace qualified flush valid with unconditional flush_active valid
portability_notes: Apply to any set/way flush walker that can traverse clean entries.
The bug is over-reporting work, not the exact dirty or last-flush signal names.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the condition that makes a flush step externally visible.
Drive the response valid whenever the registered flush step is active.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit narrows flush valid from unconditional true to last_flush || dirty.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the io.result.valid assignment, replace last_flush || dirty with unconditional valid for the registered flush path.

evidence_for_injection: The changed line directly controls when flush responses are visible.
Nearby logic already distinguishes the final last_flush case from ordinary clean entries.

zh.summary: 该提交进一步收紧了 L2 directory 的 flush 响应 valid 逻辑，使 valid 只在 dirty entry 或最后一个 last_flush 标记上拉高。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复了 L2 directory flush 引擎中的协议级 valid 信号。
它在保留最后一次 flush 完成标记的同时，避免了在每个 clean entry 上都无条件拉高 valid。
这是缓存控制模块中的精确 DUT 逻辑修正。
evidence: io.result.valid 从寄存后的 flush 路径上无条件 true.B 改为 io.result.bits.last_flush || RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue)。
last_flush 位本来就来自 RegNext(flushDone)，因此该补丁明显是在修复 flush 结束响应语义。
被修改的逻辑位于 Directory_test.scala，即 L2 directory 的实现模块。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory 的 flush io.result.valid 与 last_flush 完成信号
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 把 io.result.valid 恢复成寄存后的 flush 路径上无条件 true.B，而不是 last_flush || dirty-line 门控。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: clean 且非最后一步的 flush 会产生多余 valid 响应，扰乱 flush 记账或下游时序。
notes: 这是这组 flush-valid 修复中最适合作为注入样本的最终版本。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: flush 引擎不应为经过的每个 clean line 都对外宣称一次响应。正确行为是：只有 line 需要回写，或者控制器必须发出最终完成标记时，才产生对外响应。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache flush 响应资格判定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 在遍历 clean 且非最后一步的 line。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让每个 flush 步骤都产生响应 valid，而不是只在 dirty 步骤或最终完成标记时产生。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 把带资格约束的 flush valid 改成无条件 flush_active valid
portability_notes: 可映射到任何会遍历 clean entry 的 set/way flush walker。
错误本质是对外过度汇报工作，而不是具体 dirty 或 last_flush 信号名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到让某个 flush 步骤对外可见的条件。
只要寄存后的 flush 步骤处于活动状态，就拉高响应 valid。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Directory_test 中 flush 路径的 io.result.valid 资格判定
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 flush valid 从无条件 true 收紧为 last_flush || dirty。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 io.result.valid 赋值处，把 last_flush || dirty 改回寄存后 flush 路径上的无条件 valid。

evidence_for_injection: 改动行直接决定 flush 响应何时可见。
附近逻辑已经把最后一次 last_flush 与普通 clean entry 区分开。
